_doc: Cross-proposal edges and human judgments for the proposal wiki. Owned by the wiki layer so no proposal's own JSON is touched. Idempotent: scripts/proposal_rank.py reads this and never writes it. 'depends_on' means the first item cannot be decided cleanly before the second. 'judgments' holds 0 to 5 scores a human supplied; an absent score is shown as unscored, never guessed.

edges.why: Retiring coherence_pct as a gauge must not remove it from the API answer, which the save path reads to recompute the Y-gate. Exposure D1 decides what the answer keeps.
The echo overlap strip has no real known-good case until a planted echo is shown to fire (measurement M3).
Routing a measurement to another session only makes sense once the measurement is approved.
W2 to W4 are the cheapest three measurements approved in next-measurements D1.
The firewall numbers are decided in exposure D3.
Clinical-safety review only matters once the private test shows it is worth showing anyone.
The private log needs its gitignore line before the test starts.
